title: Integration Synthesis Standup — SE + ProServices — 2029-10-22
summary: Weekly synthesis notes for the SE + ProServices sync. Focus: Citrine Health pilot handoff, remaining infra blockers (VPC peering + IAM), canary rollout criteria, perf regressions on quantized 4-bit model variants.
agenda: 4) Model quality regression on quantized variants
discussion:
Status round-robin:
- Citrine: onboarding heartbeat ok; first 5k requests processed in dev region. They reported sporadic 504s during midday spike (10/21).
- SE: integration adapter ready; webhook signing change landed in staging but needs token rotation tested.
- ProServices: have run two simulated cutovers; DNS TTL propagation caused a 45s delay in one run, need doc update.
- SRE: VPC peering request still pending with customer networking (Alex is following up); fallback path via secure public ingress configured as a stopgap.

Infra blockers (current):
- VPC peering + route table: customer requires BGP-based routing; our private control plane currently assumes static routes. Impact: prolonged setup time and inability to test internal-only KMS key usage.
- IAM permission edge case in the dedicated agent when running under customer-managed service account — observed in canary run (error 403 on secret fetch).
- Model quantization mismatch: Citrine's evaluation harness shows a 2.1% drop in factuality when switching from fp16 to q4_0 on long-context sequences (>2k tokens).

Temporary mitigations taken:
- Enabled secure public ingress and mutual TLS between their proxy and our edge for canary traffic. This avoids waiting on peering for initial canary.
- Implemented a retry wrapper around secret fetch + exponential backoff for 403 transient errors; logging spike reduced but root fix still needed.
- Rolled canary to use fp16 for long-context and q4_0 for short-context requests; routing policy configured in the console for session length heuristic.

Canary & monitoring hooks discussed:
- Canary traffic: first 48 hours 5% of production-like load, then evaluate metrics. Metrics to watch: latency p95, token-cost-per-inference, error rate 5xx/4xx, and "generation-coherence" eval metric computed by Citrine's harness.
- Rollback criteria (immediate): >3% increase in end-user error rate or >2.5% drop in generation-coherence vs baseline in two consecutive 10-min windows.
- Alerting: Slack channel #citrine-onboarding and a PagerDuty escalation to on-call SRE if canary crosses thresholds.

Model quality deep-dive:
- Quantized variant q4_0 is performant but introduces subtle hallucination patterns on long chained prompts used by Citrine's clinical summarization workflow. Priya to run a targeted eval set (20 cases) instrumented with token-level traces.
- Suggestion: try hybrid approach: prefix-sensitivity detection that pins fp16 for initial 1–2k tokens then switch to q4_0 for remainder. Samir to assess feasibility and perf implications.

Docs / runbook gaps noted:
- DNS cutover checklist needs explicit TTL change steps and rollback commands. Jonas will author a one-page runbook.
- Handoff checklist missing exact IAM roles required for the dedicated agent; create minimal policy snippet.

Risks called out:
- Compliance delay if KMS can't be onboarded under peered network; regulatory review requires customer key management inside private network.
- If fallback public ingress is used longer than 72h, it triggers additional risk review and legal notification per contract. Keep schedule tight.

Open questions:
- Can customer's network team accept short-lived BGP sessions for peering (Alex to confirm by EOD 2029-10-23)?
- How much developer time to implement prefix-sensitivity fp16->q4 routing logic in runtime (estimate 2–3 sprints) — Product to decide priority.

Notes-to-self / loose items:
- Keep canary at 5% until we have 48h of stable telemetry; no aggressive ramp until KMS integration validated.
- Add a small synthetic eval into the canary traffic that hits 4 representative clinical templates (low cost but high signal).
- Record full kernel trace when we re-run q4_0 long-context test to debug attention cache evictions.

decision_log: Decision: Use secure public ingress + mTLS as temporary canary path until VPC peering is established (agreed 2029-10-22)
Decision: Canary traffic routing will use session-length heuristic to pin fp16 for requests >2k tokens (temporary policy)
Decision: Immediate rollback thresholds set (error rate / generation-coherence) as documented in discussion
